text: 近日，在以“智能驱动 融合共生——智能经济新形态下的金融科技”为主题的2026金融街论坛年会金融科技大会上，中国人民银行副行长、国家外汇管理局局长朱鹤新指出，“十四五”时期，两部金融科技发展规划圆满完成实施，金融数字化转型全面深化，数字技术金融应用纵深推进，金融服务质效显著提升。“十五五”时期，抢抓人工智能发展历史性机遇，以金融数字化、智能化转型为主线，积极稳妥深化“人工智能+”，安全有序推进“数据要素×”，推动金融科技向新向智发展。要重点做好四方面工作：坚持智能驱动，推动人工智能与金融双向赋能；坚持数据筑基，加快金融数据要素价值释放；坚持风险可控，筑牢
text_en: Recently, at the Fintech Conference of the 2026 Financial Street Forum Annual Meeting, held under the theme "Intelligence-Driven, Integrated Coexistence—Fintech in the New Form of the Intelligent Economy," Zhu Hexin, Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China and Administrator of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange, noted that during the 14th Five-Year Plan period, the two fintech development plans were successfully completed, financial digital transformation was comprehensively deepened, the application of digital technology in finance advanced in depth, and the quality and efficiency of financial services improved significantly. During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, we should seize the historic opportunity of AI development, take financial digitalization and intelligent transformation as the main line, actively and steadily deepen "AI+", safely and orderly advance "data elements x", and promote fintech development toward innovation and intelligence.
